title: Jacobi matrix of primes
plain: Use the primes as the off-diagonal entries of a Jacobi matrix. Known criteria for absolutely continuous spectrum just fail because prime gaps fluctuate. Decide the spectral type.
math: Let $J$ be the Jacobi matrix on $\ell^2(\mathbb N)$ with $a_n=p_n$ (the $n$-th prime) and $b_n=0$, which is self-adjoint since $\sum1/p_n=\infty$. Decide whether the spectrum of $J$ is purely absolutely continuous on $\mathbb R$.
